title: Test suites: saved references and contracts
label: Test suites
checked: Every PHP test suite that scripts/check runs, against saved references from R, lme4, mpmath, Python, and phibble, and against phit's own contracts. Each row is one suite and its own summary.
reference: Saved fixtures under tests/fixtures; each lists its generator and versions

inputs.name: Fixture provenance
inputs.detail: generators, versions, hashes, and tolerance policies

comparison.applies_to: results, row accounting, parsed values, types, and errors that must be identical
saved R fixtures for OLS and GLMs
model.matrix values (columns, terms, and rows exact); lm/glm fits use atol 1e-9, rtol 1e-7
lme4 estimates with bobyqa; likelihood 5e-6 + 1e-9·|r|, glmer as in the binomial record
fits, intervals, and standard errors; mixed models as their fits
the exposure intercept and its SE (likelihood and counts at 1e-9); identical results with and without automatic intercepts
densities, CDFs, and survival functions (logs relative to max(1, |r|), quantiles 1e-15 + 1e-12·|r|)
descriptive statistics and smoothing; exact zeros, ECDF counts, and type-7 identities exact
R inverse-CDF values; ChaCha uniforms and discrete samples exact
moments, covariance maps, affine draws, and log determinants
per-case tolerances stored in tests/fixtures/stress-r.json, scaled with the response
